function.description: Loads a data file into a list of ``InputFeatures``

examples.description: List of ``InputExamples`` or ``tf.data.Dataset`` containing the examples.

tokenizer.description: Instance of a tokenizer that will tokenize the examples

label_list.description: List of labels. Can be obtained from the processor using the ``processor.get_labels()`` method

output_mode.description: String indicating the output mode. Either ``regression`` or ``classification``

pad_on_left.description: If set to ``True``, the examples will be padded on the left rather than on the right (default)

pad_token_segment_id.description: The segment ID for the padding token (It is usually 0, but can vary such as for XLNet where it is 4)

mask_padding_with_zero.description: If set to ``True``, the attention mask will be filled by ``1`` for actual values
